measurement.memoryScope: OS actual interpreter peak working set and peak process commit are separate from sampled aggregate owned RSS/private. Windows peak_pagefile means process commit, not disk file usage. Peaks include imports/export/fidelity work; aggregate RSS can count shared pages twice and samples can miss brief peaks. Host guards include unrelated activity.
measurement.timingScope: Construction includes complete fixture parsing/native observation construction/append; indexed read and each native JSON export are separate uninstrumented spans. Full typed observation verification, hashes, imports and fixture generation are separate. One old/new case per count, no repetitions or performance acceptance threshold.

worker.notStartedReason: Available RAM below 2.5 GB before bindings; no launch or retry.
